one_line: Imperial Yadava monarch of Devagiri at the apex of the dynasty’s power in early 13th‑century western Deccan.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, athletic and broad-shouldered, with a commanding but composed presence.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jaw, straight medium nose, wheatish-brown Deccan complexion, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along the jawline, default expression calm and strategic with a faint confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a short, tidy topknot; front kept smooth with a slight wave; adorned with a simple gold circlet-style crown band set with one central deep-red stone and two smaller green stones on the sides.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length paisley-patterned silk jama-style tunic in rich deep red with subtle gold motifs, fitted at the torso and flaring slightly at the hem, over cream-coloured cotton churidar-style fitted trousers; a wide gold-embroidered belt of dark green fabric is wrapped at his waist with a small, decoratively knotted fabric tail hanging to the left; over his shoulders falls a diagonally draped, medium-weight cotton-silk shawl in muted saffron with thin green and white border stripes, pinned neatly at the right shoulder; his forearms are covered by simple polished bronze arm-guards strapped over the sleeves, and he wears plain dark brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes; minimal jewellery: small gold hoop earrings and a single gold armlet on his right upper arm engraved with a simple floral motif.
appearance.signature: A medium-length straight-bladed steel sword with a gently curving tip in a dark brown leather scabbard, carried at his left hip; the hilt has a slightly flared crossguard and dome-shaped pommel in polished bronze with a green stone set at the pommel’s center.

ref_desc: Singhana II is a wheatish-brown, strong-jawed Yadava king with black topknot and gold circlet, wearing a deep-red patterned jama, cream churidar, saffron shawl, dark green belt, bronze arm-guards and shoes, and bearing a bronze-hilted sword with dark brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Singhana II, an early 13th-century Yadava monarch from Devagiri: a late-30s, broad-shouldered man with an oval, strong-jawed wheatish-brown face, sharp dark eyes, neat moustache and short beard, and a calm, strategic expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a short topknot, front smooth with a slight wave, crowned by a simple gold circlet band featuring one central deep-red stone and two smaller green stones. He wears a rich deep-red knee-length silk jama-style tunic with subtle gold paisley motifs over cream cotton churidar-style fitted trousers, cinched by a wide dark green belt with gold embroidery and a small fabric tail knot on the left. A muted saffron cotton-silk shawl with thin green and white border stripes is draped diagonally from his left shoulder and pinned neatly at his right, and his forearms are protected by plain polished bronze arm-guards strapped over his sleeves. Show a single gold armlet with a floral motif on his right upper arm, small gold hoop earrings, and dark brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes. At his left hip, include his medium-length straight-bladed steel sword with a slightly curving tip in a dark brown leather scabbard; the hilt should have a modest flared crossguard and dome-shaped bronze pommel set with a green stone. Use deep red, muted saffron, dark green, cream, and bronze as the dominant colours, and present him in neutral front, side, and three-quarter views suitable for consistent anime-panel redrawing.
